tools.name: supabase
tools.description: Supabase MCP — execute SQL, apply migrations, tail logs, and manage edge functions for the Axiom backend.
tools.when: user asks about the database schema, wants to run a query, apply a migration, or inspect Supabase logs

tools.name: sentry
tools.description: Sentry MCP — search issues, inspect error traces, and triage production panics without leaving the session.
tools.when: user mentions a crash, panic, production error, or wants to check Sentry for recent issues

tools.name: fly
tools.description: Fly.io CLI — deploy Axiom node/worker images, manage secrets, tail live logs, and open remote shells.
tools.when: user wants to deploy, scale, inspect live logs, or SSH into a Fly machine

tools.name: axiom-dev
tools.description: Project-local dev harness (`just dev`). Boots the node + worker locally, seeds the Supabase shadow DB, and runs circuit unit tests.
tools.when: user wants to run the full local stack, seed data, or iterate on circuit logic without a remote deploy
